decision_rules: Do not claim ABI superiority without every mandatory optimized baseline.
Do not count an unreported base, tokenizer, router, cache, or artifact as free.
Do not expand data, parameters, or compute for ABI without giving matched baselines the same budget.
If conventional distillation matches ABI on quality, cost, portability, isolation, and modularity, adopt it and narrow ABI to the proven layer.
If routed LoRA wins and retaining the base satisfies the product requirement, use it and preserve the result.
Do not combine quality from one checkpoint with systems evidence from another.
Preserve all negative evidence and superseded protocols.
immediate_next_action: Execute Phase 1 only: build and certify the immutable provenance-bound normalized acquisition IR. Do not train LoRA, distillation, or LayerCake candidates before Phase 1 passes.
